about: Delivery presets for mw.py master. Integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak (dBTP). Game targets apply to the whole game mix; master every music asset of one game to one consistent level and balance against SFX in the engine's mixer. Checked 2026-10-17; see musicwright-produce RESEARCH.md R-213. lra_hint is advice in words after Oltheten, Mixing With Impact (2018) 14.5: the loudness range should suit where it plays, wide for cinema and personal listening, narrow for phones, cars and beds.

streaming.lra_hint: wide is fine: normalisation turns loud masters down, so dynamics cost nothing here
streaming.note: Spotify normalises to -14 LUFS; keep TP below -1 dBTP (-2 if the master is louder than -14). YouTube turns loud tracks down to about -14.

apple.lra_hint: wide is fine: normalisation turns loud masters down, so dynamics cost nothing here
apple.note: Apple Sound Check at about -16 LUFS (secondary sources); AES TD1008 also suggests -16 for music streams.

web-video.lra_hint: narrow: phones and laptops under speech; keep sections within a few LU of each other
web-video.note: music bed or score under web video; one level for every cue in a film.

game-music.lra_hint: narrow for beds heard for minutes under sound effects; let one-shot cues swell
game-music.note: music assets for a game, mastered consistently below the full mix; balance in the engine mixer.

game-console-mix.lra_hint: the whole mix: living-room playback allows more range than handhelds
game-console-mix.note: Sony ASWG / IESD whole-mix target (+-2 LU over a long capture). For the final game mix, not a single music file.

game-mobile-mix.lra_hint: the whole mix: narrow, for small speakers and noisy places
game-mobile-mix.note: handheld/mobile whole-mix target; sources disagree (-18 or -16).

broadcast.lra_hint: moderate: narrower than cinema, wider than phones

broadcast-us.lra_hint: moderate: narrower than cinema, wider than phones
